rules.positive: plags.json verified is true: a volunteer verified the copy
rules.unlabelled: every other candidate; excluded, never treated as a negative (R2)
rules.weak_negative: verified is false, processing.checked > 0 and processing.verified == 0: crowd-checked and never voted a copy; weaker than a positive (review finding R1)

lexical-delta-v1.description: Main's comparison service (influence.services.comparison.compare_texts) on clean edits: amendment and proposal old/new wording, both originals known

lobbyplag-stored-match.description: LobbyPlag's stored match score (plags.json match), from the matcher that proposed every candidate; a sanity baseline, unavailable for the hidden test

prose-dice.description: The edit scorer's symmetric overlap with the proposal's new wording as an insertion and its original treated as unknown: what the assessor computed for prose

prose-phrase-coverage.description: Rarity-weighted share of the amendment's inserted words that the proposal's new wording repeats as phrases of three or more words (services/prose_match.py)
